schema.text: How would you describe the availability of bicycle parking at your most frequent destination?

options.text: Very inadequate — there is nowhere secure to park my bicycle
Inadequate — parking exists but is too limited or too far from my destination
Partially adequate — parking is available but not always convenient or secure
Mostly adequate — I can usually find a suitable place to park
Very adequate — secure and convenient parking is always available

it.#How would you describe the availability: Come descriveresti la disponibilità di parcheggi per biciclette presso la tua destinazione più frequente?
it.#Very inadequate — there is nowhere secu: Del tutto inadeguata — non esiste un luogo sicuro in cui parcheggiare la bicicletta
it.#Inadequate — parking exists but is too: Inadeguata — i parcheggi esistono, ma sono troppo pochi o troppo lontani dalla destinazione
it.#Partially adequate — parking is availab: Parzialmente adeguata — il parcheggio è disponibile, ma non sempre è comodo o sicuro
it.#Mostly adequate — I can usually find a: Per lo più adeguata — di solito riesco a trovare un posto adatto
it.#Very adequate — secure and convenient p: Molto adeguata — è sempre disponibile un parcheggio sicuro e comodo

fr.#How would you describe the availability: Comment décririez-vous la disponibilité du stationnement pour vélos à votre destination la plus fréquente ?
fr.#Very inadequate — there is nowhere secu: Très insuffisante — il n’y a aucun endroit sûr pour garer mon vélo
fr.#Inadequate — parking exists but is too: Insuffisante — il y a du stationnement, mais il est trop limité ou trop loin de ma destination
fr.#Partially adequate — parking is availab: Partiellement adaptée — il y a du stationnement, mais il n’est pas toujours pratique ou sûr
fr.#Mostly adequate — I can usually find a: Plutôt adaptée — je trouve généralement un endroit convenable pour garer mon vélo
fr.#Very adequate — secure and convenient p: Très adaptée — un stationnement sûr et pratique est toujours disponible

de.#How would you describe the availability: Wie würden Sie die Verfügbarkeit von Fahrradabstellplätzen an Ihrem häufigsten Ziel beschreiben?
de.#Very inadequate — there is nowhere secu: Sehr schlecht — es gibt keinen sicheren Platz für mein Fahrrad
de.#Inadequate — parking exists but is too: Schlecht — es gibt Abstellplätze, aber zu wenige oder zu weit vom Ziel entfernt
de.#Partially adequate — parking is availab: Teilweise ausreichend — es gibt Abstellplätze, aber sie sind nicht immer praktisch oder sicher
de.#Mostly adequate — I can usually find a: Meist ausreichend — ich finde normalerweise einen geeigneten Abstellplatz
de.#Very adequate — secure and convenient p: Sehr gut — sichere und praktische Abstellplätze sind immer vorhanden

tr.#How would you describe the availability: En sık gittiğiniz yerde bisiklet parkı imkânlarını nasıl değerlendirirsiniz?
tr.#Very inadequate — there is nowhere secu: Çok yetersiz — bisikletimi güvenli şekilde bırakabileceğim bir yer yok
tr.#Inadequate — parking exists but is too: Yetersiz — park yeri var ama çok az veya gideceğim yere çok uzak
tr.#Partially adequate — parking is availab: Kısmen yeterli — park yeri var ama her zaman kullanışlı veya güvenli değil
tr.#Mostly adequate — I can usually find a: Büyük ölçüde yeterli — genellikle uygun bir park yeri bulabiliyorum
tr.#Very adequate — secure and convenient p: Çok yeterli — güvenli ve kullanışlı park yeri her zaman var

fa.#How would you describe the availability: امکان پارک دوچرخه در مقصدی که بیشتر به آن می‌روید چگونه است؟
fa.#Very inadequate — there is nowhere secu: بسیار نامناسب — هیچ جای امنی برای پارک دوچرخه ندارم
fa.#Inadequate — parking exists but is too: نامناسب — جای پارک هست، اما کم است یا از مقصد دور است
fa.#Partially adequate — parking is availab: تا حدی مناسب — جای پارک هست، اما همیشه راحت یا امن نیست
fa.#Mostly adequate — I can usually find a: بیشتر مناسب — معمولاً جای مناسبی برای پارک پیدا می‌کنم
fa.#Very adequate — secure and convenient p: بسیار مناسب — همیشه جای پارک امن و مناسب وجود دارد

hu.#How would you describe the availability: Hogyan értékelné a kerékpárparkolási lehetőségeket annál a célnál, ahová a leggyakrabban jár?
hu.#Very inadequate — there is nowhere secu: Nagyon rossz — nincs biztonságos hely a kerékpáromnak
hu.#Inadequate — parking exists but is too: Rossz — van parkoló, de kevés vagy túl messze van a céltól
hu.#Partially adequate — parking is availab: Részben megfelelő — van parkoló, de nem mindig kényelmes vagy biztonságos
hu.#Mostly adequate — I can usually find a: Többnyire megfelelő — általában találok megfelelő helyet
hu.#Very adequate — secure and convenient p: Nagyon jó — mindig van biztonságos és kényelmes parkolóhely

ar.#How would you describe the availability: كيف تصف توفر أماكن لوقوف الدراجات عند الوجهة التي تذهب إليها غالبًا؟
ar.#Very inadequate — there is nowhere secu: غير كافٍ جدًا — لا يوجد مكان آمن لترك دراجتي
ar.#Inadequate — parking exists but is too: غير كافٍ — توجد مواقف لكنها قليلة أو بعيدة جدًا عن الوجهة
ar.#Partially adequate — parking is availab: كافٍ جزئيًا — توجد مواقف لكنها ليست دائمًا مريحة أو آمنة
ar.#Mostly adequate — I can usually find a: كافٍ في معظم الأحيان — أجد عادةً مكانًا مناسبًا
ar.#Very adequate — secure and convenient p: كافٍ جدًا — يوجد دائمًا موقف آمن ومريح
